name: link-firehose-chain-saturation
description: The six-hop link firehose with 256 messages in flight, matching the host lane depth to expose sustained relay capacity and CPU per delivered packet. This complements link-firehose-chain's 16-message interactive window; receipt timeouts here are a saturation signal rather than an interactive reliability target.
conformance: sent == delivered + timeouts end to end across six hops; the trunk neither drops nor reorders on a quiet box
